items.title: 68191_William (Bill) H. Challis Oral History Interview
items.q: Lenny and I and Joe and Eddie and let's see, there were eight of us altogether.

ctx.x: Are those the ones with Crosby that Bix and Trumbauer kind of chase choruses on 'You Took Advantage of Me.' Did you do that arrangement?
No, no. Tommy Satterfield, he was in the band then. Very fine arranger, but he didn't stay too long, but then after he left they got Lenny Hayden.
